description:
crate-jmap-mime exposes a public type `JmapBodyFields` with NO derives — no Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize.

This is a public-API ergonomics gap:
- Cannot `println!("{:?}", fields)` for debugging
- Cannot serde-roundtrip
- Cannot compare two JmapBodyFields values in tests with `assert_eq!`

Per Rust API Guidelines C-COMMON-TRAITS, public structs should implement Debug + Clone at minimum, plus PartialEq/Eq/Hash/Serialize/Deserialize where reasonable.

Fix: add `#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]` (or whichever subset is reasonable given the type's contents).

Spot-check first: are there any `fn(...)` fields in JmapBodyFields that prevent these derives? If so, document why.
title: P2: JmapBodyFields (jmap-mime) has zero derives
